# function: next_id

Returns the next free VM ID as reported by `GET /cluster/nextid`, as a string. The ID is only free at the time of the check; allocating it requires creating a guest or pool with that ID.



## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
next_id() string
```
